title: Manufacturing field atlas
description: A broad inventory across 39 Central Valley, Bay Area, foothill and Central Coast counties, assembled from bulk regulatory, workplace, licensing and business-directory data. Records are manufacturing candidates, not a certified census of operating plants.

limitations: Regulatory active status does not guarantee that a factory is currently operating; classification can be secondary or historical.
Small unregulated shops can be missing; coverage is not a quantified percentage of all operating plants.
OSHA figures are employer-reported annual average workers for the stated year, not today’s exact staff count. Data Axle figures may be modeled estimates.
Reported owners can be legal entities; contacts and presidents are not assumed to be individual owners. Contacts may be undated.
Production alcohol licenses include co-located businesses and may include offices or shared production sites.
Data Axle coverage is partial; current search contains 23,461 vendor-classified manufacturing listings. It is not a plant census.
Conservative name-and-address matching preserves ambiguous co-located businesses, so some duplicate locations can remain.
US Census geocodes are street interpolations, not verified entrances. Approximate provider points are labeled. Address-only records are retained.

FSIS staffing bands describe individual establishments; Very Small can be based on revenue, so it is not converted to a headcount. Broad ranges spanning map colors are marked uncertain. FDA official correspondents may be outside regulatory contacts.

The Tracy-region EDD pass exhausts 344 county/industry searches and 930 returned regional profiles, not every operating manufacturer. Listings can be stale or misclassified; confirmed non-manufacturers were excluded.

Owner portraits are links to public, explicitly labeled source photos. No photograph is inferred from a face or synthesized. Missing portraits remain unavailable. Ownership and personnel can change after the cited source date.
Supplemental company-wide staffing stays separate from plant headcounts and does not determine pin colors.

latest_expansion.methodology: Directory and certification batch screening followed by company-level production verification. Not an exhaustive census. Current-source records include unverified directory leads.

regional_ownership_coverage.scope: Current-source location records across Tracy and 12 nearby towns; not a census of independent operating businesses.
regional_ownership_coverage.ownership_basis: Source-reported ownership; names, families and corporate parents remain distinct. Directory dates and uncertainty are retained.
regional_ownership_coverage.photo_basis: Publicly identified portraits or captioned group photographs. Archival source dates are retained.
